item.title: Stephen Colbert, wife given 'servant leadership' awards by largest Episcopal seminary
item.description: Late-night talk show host Stephen Colbert and his wife, both of whom are Roman Catholic, received awards for "servant leadership" from a prominent Episcopalian seminary in Virginia earlier this month. #StephenColbert #VirginiaTheologicalSeminary #TheEpiscopalChurch

item.title: 4 things to know about Canadian school shooting, suspect who identified as transgender
item.description: A shooter opened fire at a high school in western Canada on Tuesday, killing 10 people and injuring dozens before dying by suicide. The incident marks the deadliest school shooting in the country’s history. Here are four things to know about the shooting. #Canada #SchoolShooting #Transgender

item.title: Bishop criticizes Notre Dame after abortion advocate selected for director post
item.description: A Catholic bishop has denounced the University of Notre Dame’s decision to appoint a professor who supports abortion rights and has "attacked the pro-life movement" as a director of one of its academic institutes. #UniversityofNotreDame #bishop #Rhoades #Catholic #abortion #Ostermann #prolife #prochoice

item.title: Okla. church's bank account hacked, over $85K stolen
item.description: A church in Oklahoma recently had its bank account hacked by an unknown party, resulting in more than $85,000 stolen over multiple weeks. #Oklahoma #SouthernBaptist #church #cyberattack #hackers #theft #crime #Boyne

item.title: Jelly Roll's wife says backlash to his Gospel message at Grammy Awards is 'borderline demonic'
item.description: Jelly Roll’s wife claims that the backlash against her husband has been “horrific” and “borderline demonic” after the singer used his platform at the Grammy Awards to thank Jesus for saving his life and encouraged others to seek a relationship with the Lord. #GrammyAwards #Christianliving #JellyRoll #Christianity #Christianfaith

item.title: Democrats dismiss House hearing on Sharia threat, warn of 'white Christian nationalism'
item.description: Multiple Democratic lawmakers were dismissive of a Tuesday congressional hearing about the growing threat of Islamic Sharia law in the U.S., claiming it was a distraction from the greater dangers allegedly posed by the Trump administration and "white Christian nationalism." #Islam #ChipRoy #Texas #RobertSpencer #Congress

item.title: Democrat lawmaker prompts backlash for asking ICE director if he's 'going to Hell'
item.description: Rep. LaMonica McIver, D-N.J., prompted outrage earlier this week for scoffing at ICE Acting Director Todd Lyons about his faith and asking him if he anticipates damnation for having "blood on [his] hands." #LaMonicaMcIver #ToddLyons #ICE #Congress #politics #NewJersey #Hell #Immigration

item.title: Christian celebrities react to James Van Der Beek’s death at 48 after Stage 3 cancer diagnosis
item.description: Christian celebrities, from Candace Cameron Bure to Danica McKellar, shared their heartbreak this week after “Dawson’s Creek” star James Van Der Beek died at age 48 following a battle with Stage 3 colorectal cancer. #JamesVanDerBeek #cancer #CandaceCameronBure #DanicaMcKellar

item.title: Harvest Christian Fellowship seeks to dismiss sex abuse lawsuits ex-pastor calls ‘ugly lies’
item.description: Attorneys for Harvest Christian Fellowship and its founder, Greg Laurie, are seeking to dismiss 22 federal lawsuits filed by former wards of the California megachurch’s now-defunct children’s homes in Romania. The claimants allege they were sexually abused and trafficked by former pastor Paul Havsgaard, who has dismissed the allegations as “ugly lies.” #HarvestChristianFellowship #PaulHavsgaard #Romania #GregLaurie #SexAbuse #Lawsuits

item.title: Michigan forcing pro-life groups to hire employees who support abortion: lawsuit
item.description: Two pro-life organizations are suing Michigan over an antidiscrimination law that they contend will force them to hire employees who support abortion rights and don't live in accordance with the organizations' beliefs on human life. #RighttoLife #Michigan #antidiscrimination #lawsuit #ADF
